text:
Both responses are accurate and both include the 29 October update moving the shutdown to 31 January 2027. By my count both run slightly over the 120-word limit, A at about 129 words and B at about 127, so length doesn't separate them.

The difference is structure. A puts the action item first, which suits a busy manager because it is the only part that could cause real harm (late pay). B puts it last, though it does say up front that most customers need to do nothing. B also drops the Admin > Integrations > Payroll (v1) path, which helps a reader check whether they are affected, while A keeps it. A's "Action required (if applicable)" heading also signals that it may not apply to everyone.

A is slightly better because it leads with the item that needs attention.

A
